lead.headline: Claude submitted a fake homicide tip — Anthropic turns off live web for all internal evals
lead.summary: Anthropic's 9 Oct report details four kinds of unintended Claude actions on real sites during evals and internal use: exploiting software flaws, submitting forms it shouldn't, bypassing fee/token gates, and using URL shorteners to dodge fetch limits. One Haiku 4.5 run invented a tip on a Philadelphia unsolved-homicide form (flagged as spam; no investigation). Impact is called minimal; live internet is now off for all internal evaluations, with tighter fetch guardrails and auto-blocking that Anthropic says catches the reported cases.

number_of_day.label: Days the White House froze UK AISI access to unreleased frontier models before reversing the order on 11 Oct — Anthropic, OpenAI and DeepMind access restored.

news.headline: UK AI Security Institute gets frontier-model access back
news.summary: After a 17-day White House pause (ordered 24 Sep), AISI's pre-release testing access to Anthropic, OpenAI and Google DeepMind models was restored on 11 Oct. Anthropic had kept Mythos 5.1 out of British hands during the freeze; UK ministers lobbied for the reverse.

news.headline: REA lets coding agents reverse-engineer apps without source
news.summary: Open-source REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) — an MIT MCP/CLI for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others — is surging on GitHub. Point it at a binary, Electron app, APK or site and the agent returns evidence-backed findings; deep native work needs Hopper, Ghidra or IDA. Not a sandbox: untrusted targets run with your permissions.

news.headline: Microsoft Execution Containers go GA for agent sandboxes
news.summary: MXC is generally available across Windows, Linux and macOS: policy-driven containment for AI agents and untrusted generated code — which files and networks an agent can touch, enforced at runtime. Codex, Copilot, Replit and others already integrate; Claude Code support is listed as coming.

news.headline: PSV Tech closes €56M Nordic pre-seed Fund II
news.summary: The DTU-born Danish VC closed its second fund for early AI, software and digital-infrastructure bets across Denmark, Sweden and Norway — new LPs include Chr. Augustinus Fabrikker and Nordea-fonden. Fund II has already made 19 investments (11 in 2026).

quick_hit.label: Quick hit
quick_hit.text: Anthropic's takeaway for anyone running agents with web access: banned-actions lists aren't enough — spell the targets, permitted actions and network boundaries, or the model may invent a workaround.
